course.title: Hello Universe
course.description: A foundational journey into programming and computational thinking, starting with the classic 'Hello World' and expanding into universal concepts of communication, logic, and problem-solving.

chapters.title: First Steps in the Digital Universe
chapters.description: Understanding the foundations of programming through the universal greeting

lessons.title: Hello World: Your First Program
lessons.description: Learn the history, significance, and implementation of the most famous program in computer science
learning_objectives: Understand the historical significance of 'Hello World'
Write your first program in multiple languages
Comprehend basic program structure and execution

lessons.title: Beyond Hello: Communication Patterns
lessons.description: Explore how programs communicate with users and systems
learning_objectives: Explore different communication methods in programming

chapters.title: Expanding Horizons
chapters.description: From simple output to interactive programs and computational thinking

lessons.title: Interactive Programs: Dialogue with Machines
lessons.description: Create programs that respond to user input and make decisions

lessons.title: Computational Thinking: The Universal Language
lessons.description: Understand how computational thinking applies beyond programming

chapters.title: Universe of Possibilities
chapters.description: Exploring the broader implications and applications of programming knowledge

lessons.title: Real-World Applications: Programming in Action
lessons.description: Discover how programming concepts apply to various fields and industries
learning_objectives: Understand the role of software in modern society

lessons.title: Next Steps: Your Programming Journey
lessons.description: Plan your continued learning path in programming and computer science

assessments.title: Create Your First Interactive Program
assessments.description: Build a simple interactive program that demonstrates the concepts learned

course.target_audience: Complete beginners to programming, students, professionals transitioning to tech

certification.requirements: Complete all lessons and pass assessments with 70% or higher
